posts.post_subject: World's first movie recorded on a holographic disc
posts.content_md:
Not the first. InPhase demonstrated "The Matrix" recorded on their system three years ago. They played about 10 minutes of the movie during SPIE., however the entire movie was recorded on their holographic system.

Looking closely at this "breakthrough", it seems that the hologram is performing some sort of noise supression, rather than actually recording data holographically. The data itself seems to be recorded on lands and pits as in conventional optical disc recording.
